body: This website is operated by Precision Paint Experts, LLC, based in Newberry, FL 32669. By using the site, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site. We may update these terms from time to time, and the version posted on this page applies from its effective date.

Our service descriptions, guides, and blog articles are general information about painting and surface care in North Central Florida. They aren't a site-specific recommendation, and every property is different. Product names, timelines, and typical durations we mention describe how we usually work. They aren't a promise for any particular project. If you try a repair yourself based on something you read here, you do so at your own risk. Follow the manufacturer's instructions and safety guidance.

Sending a form, email, or phone request doesn't create a contract or obligate either of us. Estimates are free and come with no obligation. Our estimate request page describes that process. Price, scope, products, schedule, payment terms, and warranty terms for any project are set only in a written estimate or agreement that you accept. If a written project agreement conflicts with this page, the written agreement controls. No work is added to a project without your written approval.

Any workmanship warranty, including coverage of up to 10 years on exterior projects, applies only as written in your project documents. Manufacturer product warranties are provided by the manufacturer under its own terms. Nothing on this website extends, changes, or replaces the written warranty for a specific job.
